claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole agreed to fight within fifty miles of St. Louis on the 15th of next month (printed as 'i5th prox.').
claims.excerpt: the fight is to come off within fifty miles of St. Louis, on the i5th prox.,

claims.statement: The winner of the Allen and McCoole fight was to receive the stakes and excursion money.
claims.excerpt: winning man to receive stakes and excursion money.

fights.place: within fifty miles of St. Louis
fights.stakes: stakes and excursion money to the winner
fights.excerpt: the fight is to come off within fifty miles of St. Louis, on the i5th prox.,
fights.notes: Planned date from '15th prox.' (printed i5th). Other papers of the period give June 15 for this fight.

notes: Only the match terms concern Allen. McCoole's training and the Danish land item are not about Allen.
